info.title: Agentic Inbox API
info.description: REST API for Agentic Inbox. Authenticate with an API key (Authorization: Bearer aik_...) created in the web UI. verifyDraft note: the MCP server runs an AI pass over outgoing bodies; the REST API does not by default — pass verify: true on draft and send bodies to opt in.

get.description: The authenticated principal: Access identity, API key with its mailbox scope, or dev.
List API keys. The key hash and plaintext secret are never included.

201.description: Created key with its plaintext secret

post.description: Create an API key. The plaintext secret (aik_...) is returned exactly once in `secret`; only a SHA-256 hash is stored.

patch.description: Rename a key, change its expiry, or change its mailbox scope (null clears a field).

delete.description: Delete a key permanently. Requests using it stop working immediately.

post.description: Revoke a key. Verification fails immediately; the record stays for auditing.

get.description: Deployment configuration: allowed domains and pre-provisioned mailbox addresses.
List every mailbox registered in this deployment.

post.description: Create a mailbox. Restricted to configured EMAIL_ADDRESSES when set.

get.description: Get a mailbox with its settings.

delete.description: Delete a mailbox's settings object. Mail data in the Durable Object is not removed.

get.description: List emails in a mailbox. Returns { emails, totalCount }. With threaded=true, each item is a conversation with thread_count/participants aggregates.

post.description: Send a new email. Delivery happens asynchronously; the created sent email is returned immediately. Rate limit: 20/hour, 100/day per mailbox.

get.description: Get a single email with body and attachments.

put.description: Update an email's read and/or starred flags.

delete.description: Delete an email and its attachment blobs from R2.

post.description: Move an email to a folder (folder id or name).
Draft a reply to an email: saves a draft in the Drafts folder with the quoted original appended and threading set up. Does not send.
Create a draft, or replace an existing draft when draft_id is given (the old draft is deleted and recreated).

patch.description: Update a draft in place: the old draft is deleted and recreated with a new id. Omitted fields carry over from the old draft.

delete.description: Discard a draft. Only emails in the Drafts folder can be discarded.

post.description: Send a reply to an email. Threading headers are derived from the original; delivery is asynchronous. Rate limit: 20/hour, 100/day per mailbox.
Forward an email. Delivery is asynchronous. Rate limit: 20/hour, 100/day per mailbox.

get.description: Get every email in a conversation thread, oldest first, with attachments.

post.description: Mark every email in a thread as read.

get.description: List a mailbox's folders with unread counts.

post.description: Create a folder. The id is the slugified name.

delete.description: Delete a folder. Built-in folders (inbox, sent, draft, archive, trash) cannot be deleted.

get.description: Search emails with optional field filters. query matches subject, body, sender, and recipients; dates are inclusive ISO timestamps.
Download an attachment. Returns the raw file as a binary download.
